{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-wv-class-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"64328ab971ced8fbedf6cd7af236d715e2119335bf5c9e822f27e59426be4775","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-wv-class-e:lineage:6","source_registry_sha256":"2261abaab8e2b1aaff5b8a336e3bfcf845adaa75847f0210442061783d7f9afb","source_liveness_sha256":"9a1fb68777f5e9d5c4b27899084cc233b265410fee506dfe6554447a61ea026e"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"License eligibility and identity","heading":"C2 — Confusables and KG hints, License eligibility and identity","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, License eligibility and identity

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A02
A For Federal Use renewal needs the full document set of identity proof, Social Security number, two residency proofs and any name-change proof, whereas a Not For Federal Use renewal with no changes needs only the current card and the renewal application [A02].
Why it matters: group card-types; difficulty high; prereq sec02-F13; confusables sec02-F14, sec02-F19 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A01
The ninety-day calendar-year limit attaches to the general exemption for nonresident drivers at least sixteen years old with a valid out-of-state license, not to the separate exemption for nonresident college students [A01].
Why it matters: group exemptions; difficulty medium; prereq sec02-F03; confusables sec02-F03, sec02-F04 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A06
New residents have thirty days after establishing residency to apply for a West Virginia license, while an in-state address change must be reported to the DMV in writing within twenty days [A06].
Why it matters: group deadlines; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F42, sec02-F45 [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A07
A West Virginia license expired three years or more sends the holder through the full examination process as a first-time applicant, and an expired out-of-state license also requires retesting [A07].
Why it matters: group expired-licenses; difficulty medium; prereq sec02-F17; confusables sec02-F17, sec02-F47 [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A03
State Department and military birth certificates count as proof of identity, while hospital birth certificates and Bureau of Census records do not [A03].
Why it matters: group identity-proof; difficulty medium; prereq sec02-F21; confusables sec02-F21, sec02-F22 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A03
An original Wage and Tax Statement proves the Social Security number and may also serve as one residency proof if it is not more than eighteen months old, but a photocopy of it is not acceptable [A03].
Why it matters: group ssn-proof; difficulty medium; prereq sec02-F27; confusables sec02-F27, sec02-F32 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A04
A recurring residency document such as a utility bill may be no more than ninety days old, whereas a Wage and Tax Statement used as residency proof may be up to eighteen months old [A04].
Why it matters: group residency-proof; difficulty high; prereq sec02-F30; confusables sec02-F30, sec02-F32 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A04
A document showing a post office box is rejected as residency proof, while a letter from the Post Office assigning the applicant a new physical West Virginia address is accepted [A04].
Why it matters: group residency-proof; difficulty medium; prereq sec02-F30; confusables sec02-F30, sec02-F32 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A05
A suspension for an unpaid out-of-state citation follows certified-mail notice and a period to respond, and reinstatement requires the driver's own proof of payment because the court will not notify the DMV [A05].
Why it matters: group out-of-state-records; difficulty medium; prereq sec02-F38; confusables sec02-F38, sec02-F39 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A07
Red color coding marks license holders aged fifteen to seventeen and blue marks those aged eighteen to twenty, both on vertical cards, while a horizontal landscape card marks age twenty-one or older [A07].
Why it matters: group card-design; difficulty low; prereq sec02-F48; confusables sec02-F48 [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A06
A transfer applicant who presents a valid out-of-state license, or a certified driving record when that license cannot be produced, waives the testing requirement, but an out-of-state license expired more than three years brings every first-time examination [A06].
Why it matters: group transfers; difficulty high; prereq sec02-F41; confusables sec02-F41, sec02-F43 [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-R12 | anchor: A08
Non-immigrant and refugee applicants may substitute a Social Security Administration denial letter for a Social Security number, while the immigrant document list on the same page names only the Social Security number [A08].
Why it matters: group non-citizen-applicants; difficulty medium; prereq sec02-F49; confusables sec02-F49, sec02-F50, sec02-F51 [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]
